scope: Weekly maintenance review of the eight existing official release, HTTP transition, command-family, message/component, interaction and Gateway composition sources. No discovery-wide refresh or protocol implementation change.
collectionMethod: Official HTML pages were opened and inspected. Original URLs and canonical Markdown alternatives were fetched read-only over HTTPS with system curl certificate validation. Selected current contracts were compared against the 2026-10-18 recorded contract findings.
comparisonLimits: Five original Markdown sources have different byte hashes. Three original HTML sources had semantic-only historical records. Previous raw response bodies were not committed, so no byte-identical or complete historical text-diff assertion is made.

reviewedContracts: REST and Gateway API version 10 remains available; explicit versioned API origins remain appropriate.

reviewedContracts: The newest changelog entry remains the 2026-10-14 OAuth issuer response addition, already covered by the previous review.
The 2026-08-12 channel-obfuscation announcement still permits Gateway opt-in and keeps HTTP omission effective on 2026-11-16 without HTTP early opt-in.

reviewedContracts: Command identity remains application, type, name and global or guild scope. POST remains an upsert within that identity.
Options and choices retain a maximum of 25. Group nesting permits groups containing subcommands and does not permit arbitrary deeper groups.

Autocomplete retains partial supplied arguments and the focused marker; otherwise required arguments may be absent. No change to existing strict invocation decoding or explicit synchronization is required by these reviewed contracts.

reviewedContracts: Gateway receipt and outgoing-webhook receipt remain mutually exclusive, and Gateway interactions still respond through HTTP.
The initial response deadline remains three seconds from receipt; continuation tokens remain valid for fifteen minutes.
Autocomplete, modal and message-update response kinds remain distinct. Deferred message acknowledgement permits only EPHEMERAL, with Components V2 supplied using edit-original.

reviewedContracts: Components V2 still requires IS_COMPONENTS_V2, permits at most forty total components and disables legacy content, embeds, poll and stickers.
Action rows retain up to five buttons or one select. Interactive custom IDs retain a one-to-one-hundred-character limit.
Label, file-upload, radio-group, checkbox-group and checkbox modal components remain documented; no expanded model-support classification follows from this scoped review.

reviewedContracts: Message content retains a two-thousand-character limit, with up to ten embeds and a shared six-thousand-character text budget.

Allowed mentions remain constrained by the visible content and permissions and do not guarantee push notifications. Editing without an explicit allowed_mentions value uses default allowances, so existing explicit mention policies remain appropriate.

The documented API remains version 10. This review does not qualify live shard operation, capacity or any other protocol surface.
